reading.title: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the healthcare industry by improving diagnostic accuracy and patient care. AI algorithms can analyze medical images faster than human radiologists, detecting diseases like cancer at earlier stages. Additionally, AI-powered systems assist in drug discovery, reducing the time and cost of developing new medications. Machine learning models also help predict patient outcomes, enabling doctors to provide personalized treatment plans. However, concerns about data privacy and the need for proper regulation remain significant challenges in implementing AI within healthcare systems.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one advantage of using AI in medical imaging?
options: It can detect diseases like cancer at earlier stages
It eliminates the need for patient data
It reduces healthcare costs by eliminating hospitals
questions.explanation: 지문에서 AI 알고리즘이 의료 영상을 인간 방사선 의사보다 빠르게 분석하고 암과 같은 질병을 더 조기에 발견할 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about AI in drug discovery?
options: It has no impact on medication costs
It reduces both time and cost of developing new medications
It is only used for experimental purposes
questions.explanation: 지문에서 AI 기반 시스템이 신약 개발의 시간과 비용을 줄일 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a challenge in implementing AI in healthcare?
options: Data privacy concerns and need for proper regulation
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 부분에서 데이터 프라이버시 우려와 적절한 규제의 필요성이 AI 의료 구현의 중요한 과제라고 언급되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made human relationships weaker than before'?

structure.intro: 자신의 입장(동의/불동의)을 명확하게 제시하고, 2-3개의 주요 이유를 간단히 소개합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유에 대해 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다. (예: 소셜 미디어의 영향)
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이유에 대해 상세히 전개합니다. (예: 장거리 관계 유지의 용이성)
structure.conclusion: 서론의 입장을 재확인하고, 제시한 이유들을 요약하여 마무리합니다.

useful_phrases: I agree/disagree with this statement because

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in a large company with many employees. Others prefer to work in a small startup. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer working in a...
This is important to me because...
sample_points: Small companies offer more opportunities for personal growth and learning diverse skills, while large companies provide job security and structured career development.
Startup environments foster creativity and innovation, but large companies offer better benefits, salary stability, and established work processes.

listening.title: University Library Resources
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm new here and I'm looking for information about the library's online resources. Librarian: Welcome! We have an extensive collection of digital databases, e-books, and academic journals available 24/7. You can access them from anywhere using your student ID. We also offer research consultation services where librarians help you find sources for your papers. Student: That sounds great. Are there any workshops available? Librarian: Yes, we conduct weekly workshops on database searching, citation management, and academic writing. These sessions are free for all students and you can sign up on our website. Additionally, we have a specialized section for science and engineering resources with equipment like computers and specialized software. Student: Perfect! I'm majoring in environmental science, so this will be very helpful. Librarian: Excellent. I'd recommend checking out our environmental studies collection. We have partnership agreements with several environmental organizations, so we get recent publications on climate change, conservation, and sustainability.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To introduce the library's resources and services to a new student
To sign up for a research consultation
To register for workshops on citation management
questions.explanation: 사서가 새로운 학생에게 도서관의 다양한 온라인 자원, 서비스, 워크숍 등을 소개하고 있으므로, 이 대화의 주요 목적은 새로운 학생에게 도서관의 자원과 서비스를 소개하는 것입니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, what resources are available for students to access?
options: Digital databases, e-books, academic journals, and specialized equipment
questions.explanation: 사서는 디지털 데이터베이스, 전자책, 학술 저널, 그리고 과학 및 공학 섹션의 전문 장비 등 다양한 자원을 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What does the librarian suggest the student should check out?
questions.explanation: 사서는 학생이 환경과학을 전공하므로 도서관의 환경 연구 컬렉션을 확인하기를 권장했습니다.
